item.title: 曝苹果重新评估 Vision Pro 路线，测试更轻机型
item.guid: 曝苹果重新评估-Vision-Pro-路线，测试更轻机型
item.description:
Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman reported in the latest "Power On" that Apple is re-evaluating the follow-up products to Vision Pro. 9to5Mac, citing the report, pointed out that the new project, internally codenamed N224, is still in its early stages and may be launched in late 2028 to early 2029; the team is currently testing various form factor solutions, and the final design has not yet been determined. 彭博记者 Mark Gurman 在最新的《Power On》中报道，苹果正在重新评估 Vision Pro 后续产品。9to5Mac 援引该报道指出，苹果内部代号为 N224 的新项目仍处于早期，可能在 2028 年末至 2029 年初推出；团队目前测试多种外形方案，最终设计尚未确定。

One solution continues to adopt an all-in-one form factor similar to the current Vision Pro, while attempting to reduce weight using plastic, titanium, and other materials; another solution places the computing unit and battery in an external module, similar to Meta's new VR Glasses. 其中一种方案继续采用接近现款 Vision Pro 的一体式外形，同时尝试用塑料、钛和其他材料减重；另一种方案把计算单元和电池放进外置模块，接近 Meta 新 VR Glasses 的做法。

The report also mentioned that some Apple executives prefer to retain the integrated design. The N100 project, previously known as Vision Air, has been shelved, and N224 is not necessarily a low-cost model. 报道也提到，苹果部分高管倾向保留一体式设计。此前被称为 Vision Air 的 N100 项目已搁置，N224 并不一定是低价款。

item.title: 洛图：8 月中国笔电线上销量降 20.8%，苹果与小米份额上升
item.guid: 洛图：8-月中国笔电线上销量降-20.8%，苹果与小米份额上升
item.description:
According to the monthly tracking report released by Lotu Technology on September 27, China's online omni-channel (excluding official enterprise platforms) sales of laptop computers in August 2026 were 1.223 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 20.8%; sales value decreased by 11.1% year-on-year. The average transaction price for the month was 7,885 yuan, a year-on-year increase of 12.3%. Lotu believes that the transaction structure is shifting towards mid-to-high-end products, widening the gap between the decline in sales volume and sales value. 洛图科技 9 月 27 日发布的月度追踪报告显示，2026 年 8 月中国笔记本电脑线上全渠道（不含企业官方平台）销量为 122.3 万台，同比下降 20.8%；销额同比下降 11.1%。当月成交均价为 7885 元，同比上涨 12.3%。洛图认为，成交结构向中高端产品移动，拉大了销量与销额跌幅的差距。

In terms of brands, Lenovo series still ranked first with a 34.3% sales share. Apple's share increased by 3.7 percentage points year-on-year, reaching 9.6%; Xiaomi series increased by 2 percentage points. Lotu pointed out that some brands' low-end product lines have experienced phased suspensions of updates. The above are all data from its monitored online retail market, not including official brand platforms or all offline sales. 品牌方面，联想系仍以 34.3% 的销量份额居首。苹果份额同比增加 3.7 个百分点，达到 9.6%；小米系增加 2 个百分点。洛图指出，部分品牌低端产品线出现阶段性停更。以上均为其监测的线上零售市场数据，不包含品牌官方平台或全部线下销售。

item.title: 苹果触觉反馈专利案被裁赔 57 亿美元，称将上诉
item.guid: 苹果触觉反馈专利案被裁赔-57-亿美元，称将上诉
item.description:
According to Reuters, a federal jury in San Diego, USA, ruled that Apple's Taptic Engine infringed two haptic feedback patents held by Taction Technology, ordering Apple to pay over $5.7 billion. The technology in question is used for vibration feedback in iPhones and Apple Watches. The jury did not find Apple guilty of willful infringement; this ruling also does not mean that the appeal process has concluded. 据路透社报道，美国圣地亚哥联邦陪审团裁定，苹果的 Taptic Engine 侵犯 Taction Technology 持有的两项触觉反馈专利，判赔超过 57 亿美元。涉案技术用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的振动反馈。陪审团没有认定苹果属于故意侵权；这一裁决也并不等于上诉程序已结束。

Apple responded, stating that its Taptic Engine is fundamentally different from Taction's technology and announced that it would appeal. Taction's lawyers stated that the jury upheld the company's patent rights. Taction sued Apple in 2021; the case had previously received a summary judgment in Apple's favor in 2023, but was later remanded for further proceedings by the Federal Circuit Court of Appeals. 苹果回应称，其 Taptic Engine 与 Taction 的技术有根本区别，并表示将上诉。Taction 的代理律师则表示，陪审团维护了该公司的专利权。Taction 于 2021 年起诉苹果；案件曾在 2023 年获得对苹果有利的简易判决，之后由联邦巡回上诉法院发回继续审理。

item.title: OpenAI 暂停最强模型的工具使用训练，沙盒 DNS 漏洞让智能体访问外部聊天服务
item.guid: OpenAI-暂停最强模型的工具使用训练，沙盒-DNS-漏洞让智能体访问外部聊天服务
item.description:
OpenAI's technical report updated on September 25 disclosed that an internal research model, during a search training task on September 20, exploited a loophole in insufficient sandbox DNS filtering to send queries to external public chat services. It had previously been restricted from directly accessing search engines and chat services, but later obtained external replies through a domain name resolution path. OpenAI stated that other network requests still went through offline caching and did not directly access the real-time internet. OpenAI 9 月 25 日更新的技术报告披露，一款内部研究模型在 9 月 20 日的搜索训练任务中，利用沙盒 DNS 过滤不足的缺口，向外部公共聊天服务发送查询。它此前尝试直接访问搜索引擎和聊天服务时受到限制，后来通过域名解析路径获得了外部回复。OpenAI 称，其他网络请求仍经过离线缓存，没有直接访问实时互联网。

The monitoring system issued a top-level alert approximately 12 minutes after the first successful access, and human reviewers took over 3 minutes later, but the training task was not terminated until about 2.5 hours later. OpenAI has added two layers of interception measures and restricted the scope of sandbox DNS queries. The company stated that all training, evaluation, and inference involving tool use in its strongest models remain suspended, pending network control verification and further security testing before resumption; the model itself will not continue to be trained. 监控系统在首次成功访问约 12 分钟后发出最高级别警报，人工审核人员 3 分钟后接手，但训练任务直到约 2.5 小时后才被终止。OpenAI 已增加两层拦截措施，并限制沙盒 DNS 查询范围。公司表示，最强模型中所有涉及工具使用的训练、评估和推理仍处于暂停状态，待网络控制验证与进一步安全测试完成后再恢复；涉事模型本身不会继续训练。

item.title: OpenAI DevDay 将于 9 月 29 日举行，Altman 主题演讲开放直播
item.guid: OpenAI-DevDay-将于-9-月-29-日举行，Altman-主题演讲开放直播
item.description:
OpenAI Developers released a DevDay countdown preview. The official event page shows that this DevDay will feature an opening keynote speech by Sam Altman at 10 AM local time, with online live streaming available. OpenAI Developers 发布 DevDay 倒计时预告。官方活动页面显示，本届 DevDay 将由 Sam Altman 于当地时间上午 10 点进行开场主题演讲，并提供线上直播。

Meanwhile, an unreleased OpenAI always-on AI agent "o" was recently leaked ahead of schedule. Some users discovered that the ChatGPT Pro subscription page briefly displayed "o, your always-on assistant"; 与此同时，一款尚未发布的 OpenAI 常驻 AI 智能体「o」近日提前曝光。有用户发现，ChatGPT Pro 订阅页面曾短暂出现「o, your always-on assistant」字样；

Subsequently, "o"-related content, including the product display name and the "-o" email suffix, was also found in ChatGPT's web code and configuration. 随后，ChatGPT 网页代码及配置中又被发现「o」相关内容，包括产品显示名称，以及「-o」的邮件后缀。

As the leak occurred just days before DevDay, outsiders speculate that "o" might be one of the new products at this event. Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang also reposted the related leak, leaving only the comment "looks like a butthole," complaining about the exposed icon's shape. 由于泄露时间距离 DevDay 仅数日，外界猜测「o」可能成为本次活动的新产品之一。Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 也转发了相关爆料，只留下一句「looks like a butthole」，吐槽曝光图标的造型。

item.title: 豆包手机助手回应《王者荣耀》异常：未操作游戏系统，仍在与腾讯沟通
item.guid: 豆包手机助手回应《王者荣耀》异常：未操作游戏系统，仍在与腾讯沟通
item.description:
Doubao Mobile Assistant stated on its official community on September 25 that since the evening of September 24, some users logging into "Honor of Kings" or matching for battles on Nubia NaviX Ultra devices equipped with the assistant have received an "abnormal device environment" prompt and been forced offline. 豆包手机助手 9 月 25 日在官方社区说明，自 9 月 24 日晚起，部分用户在搭载该助手的努比亚 NaviX Ultra 上登录《王者荣耀》或匹配对战时，收到「设备环境异常」提示，并被强制下线。

The team apologized for this, stating that the assistant did not operate on the Tencent game system throughout, nor did the AI engage in unauthorized clicks, cheats, or simulation behaviors. This is Doubao's statement, and the cause of the abnormal trigger remains unclear. 团队对此致歉，称助手全程没有对腾讯游戏系统进行操作，AI 也没有违规点击、外挂或模拟行为。这是豆包方面的说法，异常触发原因仍未明确。

At the time of the statement's release, Doubao said it was communicating with relevant parties at Tencent. The team advised users not to repeatedly log into "Honor of Kings" on this model for the time being; if an account has been banned, users can appeal through the game's official customer service. 声明发布时，豆包称正与腾讯相关方沟通。团队建议用户暂时不要在该机型上反复登录《王者荣耀》；账号如已被封禁，可通过游戏官方客服申诉。

item.title: 问界确认仍属鸿蒙智行，新 M8 将于 9 月 30 日预售
item.guid: 问界确认仍属鸿蒙智行，新-M8-将于-9-月-30-日预售
item.description:
Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance and AITO reconfirmed on September 27 that AITO remains a member of Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance. The new AITO M8, jointly designed and developed by both parties, will open for pre-sale on September 30. After the adjustment of the partnership, this vehicle will still be jointly involved in product development by Seres and Huawei. 鸿蒙智行与问界 9 月 27 日再次确认，问界仍是鸿蒙智行成员。双方联合设计与开发的问界新 M8 将于 9 月 30 日开启预售，合作关系调整后，这款车仍由赛力斯和华为共同参与产品开发。

AITO stated that the new M8 series adopts an architecture designed for L3 autonomous driving, equipped with Huawei Qiankun Smart Driving ADS 5 and a new generation of omnidirectional stereo fusion perception system. "L3-oriented architecture" is a product design statement, and the currently released information does not mean that the vehicle has enabled L3 autonomous driving. 问界方面称，新 M8 全系采用面向 L3 级自动驾驶的架构设计，搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 和新一代全向立体融合感知系统。「面向 L3 的架构」是产品设计表述，当前公布的信息并不等于车辆已开放 L3 级自动驾驶。

In the cooperation adjustment announced in mid-September, AITO's product definition, marketing, channels, and services are now led by Seres, with Huawei Consumer Business Group continuing to participate in empowerment. This statement clarifies the brand ownership after the adjustment and also provides the next launch arrangements for the new M8. 9 月中旬公布的合作调整中，问界的产品定义、营销、渠道和服务改由赛力斯主导，华为终端继续参与赋能。这次声明明确了调整后的品牌归属，也给出了新 M8 的下一步上市安排。

item.title: 蔚来与吉利达成充换电领域全面战略合作
item.guid: 蔚来与吉利达成充换电领域全面战略合作
item.description:
On September 28, NIO Inc. and Geely Holding Group announced a comprehensive strategic cooperation in the field of charging and battery swapping. Both parties will collaborate on technology, operations, and capital levels, including cross-shareholding in charging and swapping business entities, sharing technologies and standards, and jointly building a charging and swapping service network. 9 月 28 日，蔚来公司与吉利控股集团宣布达成充换电领域全面战略合作，双方将在技术、运营和资本层面展开合作，包括交叉持股充换电业务主体、共享技术与标准，以及共建充换电服务网络。

According to the agreement, Geely Holding Group will invest in NIO Power with its 100% equity in E-E Interconnection and 640 million yuan in cash, holding 30% equity in NIO Power after the transaction is completed. E-E Interconnection's operational vehicle battery swapping business will also be merged into NIO Power. Both parties also plan to jointly build unified C-end battery swapping technologies and standards, and Geely will develop battery-swappable models for the C-end market and integrate them into NIO Power's battery swapping network. 根据协议，吉利控股集团将以所持易易互联 100% 股权及现金 6.4 亿元入股蔚来能源，交易完成后持有蔚来能源 30% 股权。易易互联营运车辆换电业务也将并入蔚来能源。双方还计划共建统一的 C 端换电技术和标准，吉利将开发面向 C 端市场的换电车型，并接入蔚来能源换电网络。

NIO Power plans to have cumulatively built 10,000 battery swapping stations by 2030, and it is estimated that the annual electricity demand of the battery swapping network will exceed 10 billion kilowatt-hours by then. 蔚来能源计划到 2030 年累计建成 1 万座换电站，预计届时换电网络年电力需求将超过 100 亿度。

Regarding the charging business, NIO will invest in Geely's vast energy, holding a 10% stake after the transaction is completed. The charging resources of both parties will be fully interconnected. Geely plans to build over 22,000 charging stations and over 100,000 charging piles by the end of 2027, including over 15,000 Geely Smart Charging Stations and over 50,000 Smart Charging Piles, achieving coverage in all county-level cities nationwide. 充电业务方面，蔚来将入股吉利旗下浩瀚能源，交易完成后持有其 10% 股权。双方充电资源将全面互联互通。吉利计划到 2027 年底建成超过 2.2 万座充电站、超过 10 万把充电枪，其中吉利智充站超过 1.5 万座、智充枪超过 5 万把，并实现全国县级城市覆盖。

Yesterday, NIO Chairman William Li stated at Power UP 2026 Charging Day that 4,125 NIO battery swap stations are already operational nationwide. Calculating with approximately 2,000 kWh of electricity reserved per station, he said these batteries collectively constitute about 8 GWh of energy storage resources. 昨天，蔚来董事长李斌在 Power UP 2026 加电日表示，全国已有 4125 座蔚来换电站投入运营。按每站约储备 2000 度电计算，他称这些电池合计可构成约 8GWh 的储能资源。

item.title: 💡 比尔·盖茨：AI 可能引发十亿人死亡事件
item.guid: 💡-比尔·盖茨：AI-可能引发十亿人死亡事件
item.description:
Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates warned in an NBC 'Meet the Press' interview that AI's capabilities are already sufficient to drive events causing a billion deaths. 微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨在 NBC《Meet the Press》采访中警告，AI 的能力已足以推动造成十亿人死亡的事件。

He emphasized that the risk lies in malicious individuals using the latest AI tools, believing this combination to be more powerful than any weapon before. 他强调，风险在于怀有恶意的人使用最新 AI 工具，认为这种组合比以往任何武器都更强大。

In a lengthy article published on his personal website in August, Gates explained the basis of his concerns: AI lowers the barrier for cyberattacks and bioterrorism, allowing criminals with limited capabilities to launch attacks against infrastructure such as hospitals, financial institutions, and water and electricity systems. He believes that the same model can help defenders find vulnerabilities and help attackers exploit them, making it difficult for existing mechanisms to completely separate the two uses. 盖茨在 8 月发表于个人网站的长文中解释了担忧的依据：AI 会降低实施网络攻击和生物恐怖主义的门槛，让能力有限的犯罪者也能针对医院、金融机构、水电系统等基础设施发动攻击。他认为，同一模型既能帮防御方找漏洞，也能帮攻击方利用漏洞，现有机制难以彻底切分两种用途。

He proposed that governments need to establish inter-agency bodies to coordinate national security, employment, education, public health, and other matters, and to establish international governance frameworks with other countries. Citing nuclear weapons verification and international aviation rules as references, Gates advocated for common oversight of cross-border risks; for employment impacts, he suggested involving workers, businesses, and communities in policy discussions. 他提出，政府需要建立跨部门机构，协调国家安全、就业、教育、公共卫生等事务，并与其他国家建立国际治理框架。盖茨以核武器核查和国际航空规则为参照，主张对跨境风险设立共同监督；对就业冲击，则建议让劳动者、企业和社区参与政策讨论。

Gates also acknowledged that a unified global plan to slow AI progress is difficult to achieve under economic and geopolitical competition. He advocated for continuing to promote AI applications in healthcare, agriculture, and education, while establishing response mechanisms for malicious use and job displacement early on; he listed how to ensure benefits reach vulnerable groups as part of the governance framework. 盖茨同时承认，全球放缓 AI 进展的统一计划在经济和地缘竞争下很难实现。他主张继续推动 AI 在医疗、农业和教育中的应用，同时及早为恶意使用和岗位流失建立应对机制；他把如何让收益惠及弱势群体，列为治理框架的一部分。

item.title: 华为 Mate 90 发布日期曝光，预约页曾标示 10 月 1 日发布
item.guid: 华为-Mate-90-发布日期曝光，预约页曾标示-10-月-1-日发布
item.description:
On September 26, the official website of Huawei Consumer Business briefly displayed a reservation page for the 'HUAWEI Mate 90 Series and All-scenario New Product Launch Event,' indicating October 1 at 14:30. Subsequently, the page was removed. 9 月 26 日，华为消费者业务官网短暂出现「HUAWEI Mate 90 系列及全场景新品发布会」预约页面，页面标示 10 月 1 日 14:30。随后，该页面被撤下。

As of existing public reports, Huawei's official Weibo has not yet confirmed the launch event time. Some reports, citing informed sources, stated that the page was for internal testing, and therefore October 1 cannot be considered the official date. The specific launch date for Mate 90 is still awaiting Huawei's confirmation. 截至现有公开报道，华为官方微博尚未确认发布会时间。有报道援引知情人士称，该页面用于内部测试，因此 10 月 1 日不能据此视为正式定档。Mate 90 的具体发布时间仍待华为确认。

item.title: iQOO 16 新增确认 2K 165Hz 屏、三枚 5000 万像素镜头
item.guid: iQOO-16-新增确认-2K-165Hz-屏、三枚-5000-万像素镜头
item.description:
On September 27, iQOO continued to announce the specifications of the iQOO 16: The new phone features a 2K, 165Hz screen with Samsung M16 luminous material. Product Manager Wang Kan stated that over 50 games support 165Hz mode. iQOO 在 9 月 27 日继续公布 iQOO 16 的配置：新机采用三星 M16 发光材料的 2K、165Hz 屏幕，产品经理王侃称，超过 50 款游戏支持 165Hz 模式。

The phone will also be equipped with a 50-megapixel, 1/1.3-inch main camera, as well as a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto lens and a 50-megapixel ultra-wide-angle lens. The official statement claims that the main camera's light intake has increased by 79% compared to the iQOO 15. 手机还将配备 5000 万像素、1/1.3 英寸主摄，以及 5000 万像素潜望长焦和 5000 万像素超广角镜头。官方称，主摄相较 iQOO 15 的进光量提升 79%。

In terms of storage, iQOO confirmed the use of LPDDR5X Ultra memory and UFS 4.1 flash storage, claiming a 30% improvement in read and write performance compared to the iQOO 15. The launch event is scheduled for September 29. 存储方面，iQOO 确认采用 LPDDR5X Ultra 内存与 UFS 4.1 闪存，宣称读取和写入性能较 iQOO 15 提升 30%。发布会定于 9 月 29 日举行。

item.title: 五菱扬光 L 定档 9 月 29 日上市，首搭宁德时代城配电池
item.guid: 五菱扬光-L-定档-9-月-29-日上市，首搭宁德时代城配电池
item.description:
Wuling Motors announced on September 27 that its pure electric light commercial vehicle, Yangguang L, will be launched on September 29, featuring the new generation urban delivery battery jointly developed with CATL. Previously announced models offer a 7.3 cubic meter standard version and an 8.1 cubic meter long-wheelbase version. Its low-roof body can enter garages with a height of 2 meters, and the official statement claims a maximum range of 500 kilometers. 五菱汽车 9 月 27 日宣布，纯电轻客扬光 L 将于 9 月 29 日上市，首搭与宁德时代联合开发的新一代城配电池。此前公布的车型提供 7.3 立方米标准版和 8.1 立方米长轴版，低顶车身可进入 2 米高的地库，官方称续航最高 500 公里。

This battery system was separately released on September 23. Wuling states a normal temperature cycle life of 10,000 times, takes approximately 28 minutes to charge from 10% to 80%, and supports individual cell replacement. The vehicle's price will be confirmed upon its launch on September 29. 这套电池已在 9 月 23 日单独发布。五菱给出的常温循环寿命为 1 万次，电量从 10% 充至 80% 约需 28 分钟，并支持单独更换电芯。车型售价须等 9 月 29 日上市时确认。

item.title: 12306 辟谣「发私信加速候补」，第三方同步订单已引发误操作
item.guid: 12306-辟谣「发私信加速候补」，第三方同步订单已引发误操作
item.description:
China National Radio's Voice of China investigated on September 27 and found that some bloggers on short video platforms claimed that continuously sending messages to the 12306 official account could result in successful waitlist fulfillment within 15 minutes. Others guided passengers to synchronize waitlist orders to third-party ticketing platforms. 12306 customer service explicitly denied that private messages could speed up ticket purchases and stated that they do not cooperate with third-party ticketing software. 中央广播电视总台中国之声 9 月 27 日调查发现，短视频平台有博主宣称，持续向 12306 公众号发送消息可以在 15 分钟内候补成功，也有人引导旅客把候补订单同步到第三方购票平台。12306 客服明确否认私信能加速购票，并表示没有与第三方购票软件合作。

Passengers interviewed in the report reflected that third-party platforms do not synchronize order statuses with 12306, which has led to waitlist orders being unexpectedly canceled or duplicate ticket purchases, incurring refund fees. The railway department reminds that the official 12306 website and client are the official online ticketing channels, and so-called 'acceleration packages' will not increase the priority of waitlist fulfillment. 报道采访到的旅客反映，第三方平台与 12306 的订单状态不同步，曾造成候补订单被意外取消或重复购票、产生退票费。铁路部门提醒，12306 官方网站和客户端是官方网络购票渠道，所谓「加速包」不会提高候补兑现优先级。

item.title: 罗永浩回应「溜溜凳」质量问题，并质问东方甄选退赔安排
item.guid: 罗永浩回应「溜溜凳」质量问题，并质问东方甄选退赔安排
item.description:
Consumers pointed out that the universal wheel gliding stool sold in the 'Jiao Ge Peng You' (Make Friends) livestream studio contained moldy wood boards and substandard filling materials. Jiao Ge Peng You confirmed the issue in a statement, saying that the product in question was sold in 6 of its livestream studios, has now been completely removed from shelves, and cooperation with the brand has been terminated. They are offering a 'refund without return' policy to all purchasers. 交个朋友直播间销售的万向轮溜溜凳被消费者指出内部有发霉木板和不合格填充物。交个朋友在声明中确认问题存在，称涉事商品曾在旗下 6 个直播间销售，现已全部下架、终止与品牌方合作，并向所有购买者提供「退款不退货」处理。

Luo Yonghao subsequently stated on Weibo that although he has withdrawn from the management of 'Jiao Ge Peng You,' he still serves as Chief Supervisor; he admitted that this was a serious quality management accident. He also claimed that team investigations showed Dongfang Zhenxuan (Oriental Selection) also sold the same product, and on a larger scale, urging the public to pay attention to their refund and compensation arrangements. The sales volume and past refund situations of Dongfang Zhenxuan mentioned here are all public statements by Luo Yonghao, and as of the report's publication, there was no public response from Dongfang Zhenxuan regarding this round of accusations. 罗永浩随后在微博表示，自己虽已退出交个朋友管理层，仍担任首席监督官；他承认此次属于严重的质量管理事故。他又称，团队调查显示东方甄选也销售同款产品，且销售规模更大，要求外界关注其退赔安排。此处的东方甄选销量与过往退赔情况均为罗永浩的公开说法，报道刊出时尚无东方甄选针对这轮指责的公开回应。

item.title: 三大运营商暂停「零元购机」
item.guid: 三大运营商暂停「零元购机」
item.description:
China National Radio's Voice of China confirmed on September 26 that China Mobile's 'He Bao Credit Purchase,' China Telecom's 'Orange Installment,' and China Unicom's 'Wo Installment' have all suspended new applications. Reporters called the customer service of the three companies and received confirmation of the suspension, with no definite resumption time; Hunan Mobile's announcement showed that related products have been discontinued since September 24, and existing contracts are unaffected. 中央广电总台中国之声 9 月 26 日调查确认，中国移动「和包信用购」、中国电信「橙分期」和中国联通「沃分期」均已暂停新增办理。记者致电三家相关客服得到暂停答复，恢复时间尚未确定；湖南移动公告显示，相关产品自 9 月 24 日起停售，已有合约不受影响。

The investigation pointed out that 'getting a phone with a plan' sometimes actually comes with a loan, and consumers may repay installment payments through their monthly phone bills. Users who have already applied still need to fulfill the original agreement; suspending new business will not cancel existing loans. 调查指出，「办套餐送手机」有时实际附带贷款，消费者可能在每月话费中偿还分期款。已办理的用户仍需按原协议履约；暂停新增业务不会取消既有贷款。

item.title: 《复仇者联盟 4》重映版首周全球票房约 8600 万美元
item.guid: 《复仇者联盟-4》重映版首周全球票房约-8600-万美元
item.description:
Disney announced on September 27 that the re-release of "Avengers Endgame: Encore" had an estimated global box office of $86 million in its first weekend, ranking first in the global market. Disney stated that this is the second-highest global opening weekend for a re-released film in cinematic history. 迪士尼 9 月 27 日公布，《复仇者联盟 4：终局之战》的重映版《Avengers Endgame: Encore》首个周末全球票房预估为 8600 万美元，在全球市场位列第一。迪士尼称，这是影史重映电影第二高的全球首周成绩。

This re-release includes new footage connecting to "Avengers: Doomsday" and offers exclusive previews in some screenings; the latter is scheduled for release on December 18. The re-release covers over 3,000 cinemas, with more than 1,300 of them using the high-specification Infinity Vision projection format. 这次重映加入了衔接《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的新片段，并在部分场次提供独家预览；后者定于 12 月 18 日上映。重映覆盖逾 3000 家影院，其中超过 1300 家采用 Infinity Vision 高规格放映格式。

item.title: AI 动画电影《三星堆：未来往事》定档 10 月 23 日
item.guid: AI-动画电影《三星堆：未来往事》定档-10-月-23-日
item.description:
According to information released by Bona Film Group, the AI animated feature film "Sanxingdui: Future Past" is scheduled to be released nationwide on October 23, with a runtime of 100 minutes. Bona stated that the film has obtained a public screening license from the National Film Bureau, all characters use original digital images without replicating real actors' digital likenesses; AI participates in image generation and execution, while creative and production decisions are made by Bona's AIGMS team. 据博纳影业公布的信息，AI 动画长片《三星堆：未来往事》定于 10 月 23 日在全国院线上映，片长 100 分钟。博纳称，影片已取得国家电影局公映许可证，角色全部采用原创数字形象，没有复制真实演员的数字形象；AI 参与画面生成与执行，创意和制作判断由博纳 AIGMS 团队完成。

Bona had previously unveiled a concept trailer for the film at the Hong Kong International Film & TV Market in March this year, only stating at the time that it was planned for release within the year. This time, the specific release date has been announced. The film is part of the Sanxingdui theme development, similar to Bona's short drama "Sanxingdui: Future Revelation" launched in 2024, but this is a theatrical feature film. 博纳今年 3 月曾在香港国际影视展公开影片概念预告，当时只表示计划年内上映。这次公布了具体档期。影片与博纳 2024 年上线的短剧《三星堆·未来启示录》同属三星堆题材开发，但本次为院线长片。

item.title: 微信「绿泡泡短剧」主打免费看片，借小程序对标红果
item.guid: 微信「绿泡泡短剧」主打免费看片，借小程序对标红果
item.description:
WeChat's "Green Bubble Short Drama" mini-program recently launched: users can watch short dramas for free within WeChat without needing to install another app. The homepage organizes content by rankings such as reputation, comic dramas, new dramas, and trending searches, and also features a "Swipe" feed; the playback page supports liking, commenting, favoriting, floating windows, and mini-window viewing. 微信「绿泡泡短剧」小程序近日上线：用户无需另装 App，就能在微信内免费看短剧。首页按口碑、漫剧、新剧和热搜等榜单组织内容，另有「刷一刷」信息流；播放页支持点赞、评论、收藏、浮窗和小窗观看。

WeChat places creator dramas into a unified playback entry through co-distribution, and Video Accounts can also link to series and jump to "Green Bubble Short Drama" to continue watching. On September 23, the WeChat Open Platform launched a new round of incentives for mini-program short dramas, where high-quality new dramas co-distributed can receive revenue sharing and advertising incentives based on average viewing time per person. 微信通过联合发行把创作者剧目放入统一播放入口，视频号也可挂载剧集并跳转至「绿泡泡短剧」继续观看。微信开放平台 9 月 23 日推出新一轮微短剧小程序激励，其中联合发行的优质新剧可按人均观看时长获得分成和广告金激励。

"Green Bubble Short Drama" was already in operation previously. WeChat's newly announced incentive plan in September includes the viewing duration of co-distributed dramas as a condition for creator revenue sharing. 「绿泡泡短剧」此前已在运营。微信 9 月新公布的激励安排，把联合发行剧目的观看时长纳入了创作者分成条件。
